newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore hangs three for drug smuggling, murder.
newsitem.headline: Singapore hangs three for drug smuggling, murder.

text.p: Singapore hanged three people on Friday for drug smuggling and murder, the Prisons Department said.
Two Singaporeans were executed for drug smuggling and the third for murder, an official said. No further details were immediately available.
The city-state normally carries out executions on Friday.

Singapore has tough anti-drug laws including a mandatory death sentence for anyone over 18 found guilty of trafficking in more than 15 grams (half an ounce) of heroin, 30 grams (an ounce) of morphine or 500 grams (18 oz) of cannabis.
Of the nearly 300 people hanged in Singapore since 1975, well over half have been for drug-related offences.
